user.title: Add an amaran light
user.description: Choose a fixture to add. It must be factory reset and not paired with the amaran app.

confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description:
Home Assistant will provision {name} ({address}) into its own private Bluetooth Mesh network.

The fixture must already be factory reset. After setup, the amaran app will not see it until you factory reset it again. Verify that the address belongs to the intended amaran fixture before continuing.

data_description.model: Choose the exact app model to apply its cataloged light modes, rated color-temperature range, effects, fan, and Boost capabilities. Ace 25x is hardware-tested; every other named profile is experimental. Use Generic only when the model is not listed.
data_description.supports_cct: Turn this off for fixed-daylight fixtures. Models ending in 'x' normally support this; models ending in 'd' normally do not.
data_description.supports_color: Enable this for full-colour fixtures such as models ending in 'c'.
data_description.supports_gm: Adds a separate G/M slider. Enable it only when the fixture supports tint adjustment in CCT mode.
data_description.min_kelvin: Use your fixture's rated range; it is ignored when adjustable colour temperature is off.
data_description.max_kelvin: The protocol carries 800 K to 20000 K; use the fixture's rated maximum.

reconfigure.title: Re-provision {name}
reconfigure.description: Choose the factory-reset fixture that should remain linked to {name}. Home Assistant will create fresh Bluetooth Mesh credentials while preserving this integration entry, its device, and all entity IDs.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the fixture. Move it closer to a Bluetooth adapter or proxy and try again.
error.no_devices_found: No factory-reset amaran fixture is visible. Power on and factory reset the intended light, then try again.
error.provisioning_failed: Provisioning failed. Factory reset the fixture and try again.
error.invalid_range: The maximum colour temperature must be higher than the minimum.
error.gm_requires_cct: Green/magenta adjustment requires adjustable colour temperature.
error.color_requires_cct: Full-colour control requires adjustable colour temperature.
error.already_provisioned: This fixture belongs to another Bluetooth Mesh network, most likely the amaran app's. Factory reset the light and try again.

abort.already_configured: This fixture is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No amaran fixtures found. Make sure the light is powered on and factory reset.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported amaran fixture.

abort.entry_removed: The integration entry has already been removed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not verify the fixture's live provisioning service. Move it closer to a Bluetooth adapter or proxy and try again.
error.no_devices_found: No factory-reset amaran fixture is visible. Power on and factory reset the intended light, then try again.
error.provisioning_failed: Re-provisioning failed safely. The existing Home Assistant entry was not replaced; factory reset the fixture and try again.

init.title: Re-provision {name}
init.description: Select the physical fixture that belongs to {name}. Submitting the form provisions it into Home Assistant's private Bluetooth Mesh and updates the existing entry in place. If no fixture is listed, factory reset and power on the intended light, then submit to scan again.

init.title: Fixture capabilities
init.description: These cannot be read over Bluetooth Mesh, so set them to match your fixture.

data_description.model: Named models use capabilities extracted from the app. Ace 25x is hardware-tested; all other named profiles are experimental. Generic uses the capability fields below.
data_description.supports_cct: Turn this off for fixed-daylight fixtures.
data_description.supports_color: Enable this for full-colour fixtures with HSI control.
data_description.supports_gm: Adds a separate G/M slider and requires adjustable colour temperature.
data_description.min_kelvin: The warmest value shown in Home Assistant; ignored when adjustable colour temperature is off.
data_description.max_kelvin: The coolest value shown in Home Assistant, up to the protocol limit of 20000 K.

error.invalid_range: The maximum colour temperature must be higher than the minimum.
error.gm_requires_cct: Green/magenta adjustment requires adjustable colour temperature.
error.color_requires_cct: Full-colour control requires adjustable colour temperature.
